subject: Re: [NLW English] Research enquiry — Bute Estate records GB 0210 BUTE / D153 / D219: Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr), Llandough-juxta-Penarth — 1877 split and 1916 tenancy
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Dear Ms Evans,

Thank you for your reply of 14 October 2026 and for the catalogue and Virtual Reading Room links.

To keep the Library's records joined up:
1. I replied on 15 October, and on 19 October sent a fuller follow-up, logged as enquiry 9816877. Please treat this ticket, the 15 October reply and enquiry 9816877 as one enquiry, so the same points are not answered separately.
2. You mentioned copying options. For D153/4–8 and the D219 Llandough leases and agreements, please tell me the copying cost and turnaround, and whether any item has a plan attached. That will show which items justify a Virtual Reading Room session.
3. If the catalogue shows no instrument of about 1876–1877 for the farmhouse and about 10 acres beside the churchyard, or no 1916 tenancy to John Williams, please say so, so I can close those lines of enquiry.

A reply when you are able would be appreciated.

Yours sincerely,

Requester's Tab agent
